purpose: Locate published answers, reports and investigation records using safe identifiers without exposing private case information or conflating different properties, dates or questions.
public_search_fields: general_property_area_or_non-identifying descriptor where publication is appropriate
identity_rules: Do not merge records merely because addresses or names look similar.
Property-specific searches should use authoritative property identifiers where available.
Different target dates remain distinct answer scopes.
Different legal questions about the same property remain distinct investigations unless explicitly linked.
Shared evidence does not imply identical answers.
Historical and current reports must remain distinguishable.
public_visibility_rules: Only published/public-safe snapshots enter the public index.
Private case identifiers never become public search keys.
Restricted personal data is excluded from public indexing.
Public search results expose only metadata necessary to locate the public answer.
Unpublished or withdrawn material is not exposed through the public index.
ranking_rules: Exact topic and date scope next.
General text relevance only after identity and publication filtering.
Ranking must never imply legal correctness or answer quality.
hard_stops: Never reveal private cases through search.
Never use search similarity as proof that two properties are the same.
Never conflate current and historical reports.
Never turn search ranking into an evaluative legal ranking.
